reason: A conversation-management utility that provides confirmed deletion through the session menu and slash command, hides sessions immediately, and moves eligible logs to recoverable trash after restart.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带确认的会话删除功能，支持会话菜单和命令操作，并在重启后将符合条件的日志移入可恢复回收目录。
summaries.en: Provides confirmed conversation deletion for DeepSeek Harness through the session menu and slash command, with immediate hiding and recoverable log archiving after restart.

capabilities: Adds a session-menu action and slash command for deleting conversations
Immediately hides selected sessions from workspace projections
Moves eligible JSONL session directories to recoverable trash on the next cold start
